name: What is involved in the door installation process?
description: The process involves consultation, old door removal, new frame installation, hanging the new door, hardware setup, weather stripping, and finishing trim work.

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the door installation process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The door installation process typically begins with an initial consultation and measurement. Once the door is selected, the old door and frame are carefully removed. The new door frame is then prepared and installed, ensuring it is level and plumb. The new door is hung, hardware is installed, and proper weather stripping is applied for exterior doors. Finally, trim work is completed, and the area is cleaned. Throughout the process, our installers ensure a precise fit and smooth operation for optimal performance and appearance.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, old door removal, new frame installation, hanging the new door, hardware setup, weather stripping, and finishing trim work.
